Tell Us About Your Rollout Programme UK Services

The Multi-Site Documentation Problem in UK Rollout Programmes

Inconsistent photos from different surveyors. Measurements in different formats. No way to compare one location to another. No permanent record that survives staff turnover. UK retail, QSR, and hospitality rollouts run on dozens or hundreds of locations — and most start with documentation that was never designed for scale.

  • Inconsistent photos and formats across locations
  • Measurements that don't align between sites
  • No comparison baseline for design and fit-out
  • No permanent, structured record for the programme

What Standardised Site Documentation Looks Like

Navigable Digital Twin

Dimensionally accurate, explorable remotely. Same format at every location. Compare sites side by side.

Conditions Report (P1/P2/P3)

Findings prioritised consistently. What matters for design, cost, and programme — at every location.

Equipment and Asset Schedule

Fixture counts, makes, models, services connections. Reuse, replace, or relocate — with full visibility across the programme.

Labelled Photo Storyboard

Area-by-area documentation via ScopeWalk. Structured, searchable, shareable. Same structure at every site.

Narrated Video Walkthrough

Spoken commentary on conditions, concerns, and findings. The closest thing to walking the space with someone who's been there.

ScopeWalk Platform Access

Permanent, structured, shareable. All deliverables accessible through one platform for your rollout team.

Why Single-Vendor Documentation Makes UK Rollouts Run Better

  • One brief — same scope, same deliverables, every location
  • One format — compare locations, no translation between surveyors
  • One point of contact — programme-level coordination, not per-location handoffs
  • Consistent quality control — same standards, same training, same output
  • All-in pricing — no per-location additions, no travel surprises
